stand: stand61.onnx at zero command (walk mode, vx 0)
sit: sit mode; policy goals clamped to the trained ranges (CURRENT-STATE policy_goal_guards)

getup: walk_brain recover mode (DUCK_GETUP=recover); sim only, never run on the robot (CURRENT-STATE getup)
wait: stand61 at zero command
stop: zero velocity command; walk61 brings its stride to rest
look_around: head yaw sweep within its trained range; rules-table bounds
turn_head: joint ranges; while walking only head pitch is robot-tested (2026-10-24)
nod: rules-table bounds
shake_head: rules-table bounds
beak: jaw limits in software (pi/jaw_limits.py): head pitch <= 65 deg while open

devices.name: speaker
devices.notes: head speaker, ALSA default, -3 dB softvol ceiling

channels.space_note: head outputs are walk_brain head-command deltas from the policy default pose (HEAD_JOINTS order neck_pitch, head_pitch, head_yaw, head_roll); the stand/walk policy tracks them
channels.motion_lag_note: head_yaw joint 0.12-0.16 s behind the head command under stand61 (as-built sim, pet/express/out/duck_tilt.json track_lag_s); calls are delayed by it to land with the head

ATTEND.note: sim signs (as-built MuJoCo head camera): head_yaw + turns left, head_pitch + looks up, neck_pitch + lowers the head

ORIENT.note: the head counter-rotates while the body turns; body_heading is a heading goal for walk_brain's heading controller (walk61, robot-tested turns +-0.3 rad/s); not exercised under the stand policy

POSTURE.note: alert = neck back and head up, gaze kept near level; slumped = neck forward

VOCALISE.note: duck_sound.Voice recordings, resampled for pitch and stretched for length (pet/express/voice.py)

neck_pitch.note: inside HEAD_RANGE 1.10; neck moves tilt the trunk (pet/state/examples/duck.json body schema 15 deg/rad)
